tokens.npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin_bio:
Deep in the Archive of Ultimyr, shelved between scholarly treatises on dragon cladistics and books of untranslatable spells, there is an ancient tome of entomological curiosities. Compiled by scholars, the book describes the telepathic talents of the zealot scarab, a strange species of social insect with abilities unique to all the seven planes.

Unlike most grubs of his colony, Nyx Assassin did not arise from metamorphosis with the plodding thoughts and blunted appendages common to the worker caste of his kind. For his was a special transformation, guided by the grace of Nyx. He was the chosen one, selected from the many and anointed with an extract of the queen goddess herself. Not all survive the dark blessing of the queen's chamber, but he emerged with a penetrating mind, and dagger-like claws--his razor sharp mandibles raking the air while his thoughts projected directly into the minds of those around him. Of all zealot scarabs, he alone was selected for the highest calling. After his metamorphosis, he was reborn, by grace of Nyx, with abilities which shaped him for one thing and one thing only: to kill in the name of his goddess.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin_hype: Nyx Assassin is always hunting for fragile targets. Sneaking invisibly through the forest, when he spots his prey, he swipes them with his deadly claws and impales them on stunning spikes, then reverses any counterattack with his reflecting carapace.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|a|Counter}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|nyx_assassin_jolt_damage_tracker}}
*** Applies a modifier that accumulates all damage instances from all [[damage type]]s on all heroes upon learning the ability, including Nyx itself.
*** Does not accumulate damage from the following sources:
**** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
**** {{M|No-reflection}} flag damage sources.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*** All ability effects are applied immediately despite the visual effects, and cannot be {{M|disjointed}}.
*** {{cf|talnotes}} The {{M|talent|t=t4r}} upgrade causes the ability to apply all offensive components to enemy units within the radius, centered around enemy unit [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] .
**** Hence, the ability must still be {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted.
**** [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-3-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-3-2.png|84px]]
***** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Mind Flare cast range}}+{{#var:Mind Flare type2 value1}}}}|25tal}} ({{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Mind Flare type3 value1 agh}}+{{#var:Mind Flare type2 value1}}}}|aghtal}})-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
**** Affects the following secondary units:
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
***** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Arrow 180 Line icon.png|21px|link=#Burrow|Burrowed]]
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} While {{A|Nyx Assassin|Burrow|text=Burrowed}}, Mind Flare does not require Nyx {{M|Facing Angle|text=facing}} the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy or the {{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} {{ValueColor||area-targeted location|25tal}} to cast the ability.

* The ability effects are applied as follows per affected enemy unit:
*# {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}}
*#* Applies a single [[magical]] [[spell damage]] instance in the {{M|combat log}}, and is defined as:
*#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|SplDmg {{=}} (EnemyMAX[[Mana]] × {{#var:Mind Flare value2}}) + (DamageCounter × {{#var:Mind Flare value3}})}}
*#** Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
*#** Applies only the accumulated damage to units without {{M|mana}}.
*#* Applies a 0-damage instance in the following conditions:
*#** {{M|Ancient creeps}} with no mana.
*#** When both the unit's {{M|current mana}} and the accumulated damage value is 0.
*# Applies {{A|Nyx Assassin|Mana Burn}} corresponding to the applied {{M|spell damage}}.
*# Offensively removes the affected unit's max {{M|mana}}.
*# {{Symbol|a|Counter}} 
*#* Resets the damage counter.
*#* The damage counter also resets upon the unit's {{M|death}}.
*#** Hence, recasting the ability on the same unit only counts the damage instances since the last time the ability was cast, including the bonus damage instance of Mind Flare.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: While above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects, negates one damage instance per damage source, and stuns the damage source as well.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Spiked Carapace under the scarab's hood is akin to wielding a Blade Mail.

Damage reflected from the item's active ability deals {{#var:Spiked Carapace type1 value1}}-damage instances while Spiked Carapace is active.

fields.name: interacts
buff2text
fields.value: Spiked Carapace: The next player-owned damage instance will be reflected, damaging and stunning the hero that caused it.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Neither works on nor affects the following units:
** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
** {{M|Buildings}}
** {{M|Lane creeps}}.
** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

* Both the {{M|damage negation}} component and {{M|damage reflect}} component are independent of each other.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#* Recasting the ability refreshes the buff duration.
*#* Interrupts Nyx's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
*#* Does not break {{A|Nyx Assassin|Vendetta}}'s {{M|invisibility}} upon cast, but not other invisibility sources.
*#* {{Symbol|Damage Negation}}
*#** Grants Nyx {{#var:Spiked Carapace value3}} [[damage negation]] instance per incoming damage sources, causing certain {{M|on-damage effects}} to not proc.
*#** Has precedence over {{M|damage barrier}} sources.
*#** Does not prevent Nyx's {{M|death}}.
*#** Does not interact with the following sources:
*#*** {{M|Forced kill}} and {{M|instant kill}} sources.
*#*** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
*#*** {{M|Reflected damage}} instances.
*# [[File:Dota2 Arrow 180 Line icon.png|21px|link=#Burrow|Burrowed]]
*#* {{cf|aghnotes}} While {{A|Nyx Assassin|Burrow|text=Burrowed}}, casting Spiked Carapace immediately applies {{Symbol|Stun}} {{Code|modifier_[[stun]]ned}} to all enemy units within {{ValueColor||{{#var:Spiked Carapace type3 value1 agh}}|agh}} radius.
*#** Affects the following units:
*#*** {{M|Lane creeps}}.
*#*** {{M|Neutral creeps}}.
*# {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*#* Procs the following component per applied damage instance, per unit, per Spiked Carapace cast, in the {{M|combat log}}:
*#** {{Symbol|Stun}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|[[stun]]ned}}
*#*** {{cf|aghnotes}} Hence, enemy units stunned this way cannot be affected by this ability component again per cast.
*#** {{Symbol|Damage|Reflect}}
*#*** The [[damage reflection]] component has the following properties:
*#**** Can only affect the same enemy units once per cast.
*#**** Only reflects player-based damage back to its damage source, and is defined as:
*#***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|ReflectDmg {{=}} SourceDmg × {{#var:Spiked Carapace value2}} OR {{ValueColor||{{#var:Spiked Carapace value2 tal}}|tal|x}}}}
*#*** The incoming damage instance reflected is the same [[damage type]] as the source [[before reductions]], either {{M|attack damage}} or {{M|spell damage}}, corresponding to the incoming ability's properties, with the {{M|HP Removal}} flag.
*#*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Flag}}
*#**** Utilizes {{I|Blade Mail}}'s properties, has precedence over it, with the following flags:
*#***** {{M|No-reflection}} flag.
*#***** {{M|No-spell-lifesteal}} flag.
*#***** {{M|No-spell-amplification}} flag.
*#**** Affects the following units:
*#***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*#***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*#** Applies {{A|Nyx Assassin|Mana Burn}} corresponding to the applied {{M|damage reflection}} value.

** Asides from the aformentioned Nyx's abilities, other {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} targeted abilities, and {{M|items}} still require facing the target to cast within its {{M|cast range}}.

* The following conditions unburrows Nyx Assassin:
** Upon the {{A|Nyx Assassin|Unburrow}} sub-ability or {{A|Nyx Assassin|Vendetta}} cast.
** Upon Nyx's {{M|death}}

* This ability has two main components:

*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|nyx_assassin_vendetta}}
**** Does not interrupt Nyx's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
**** Grants the following bonuses while active:
***** {{M|Invisibility}}
****** Does not break invisibility in the following conditions:
******* {{M|Missed}} attacks.
******* Items being picked up, dropped, or attacked.
******* {{M|Denying}} {{M|runes}}.
******* Upon {{A|Nyx Assassin|Spiked Carapace}} cast.
***** {{M|Phase movement}}.
***** {{M|Attack range}} bonus based on the caster's attack range type.
***** Reduces the {{M|attack point}} of the next attack.

*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|nyx_assassin_vendetta_fast}}
**** {{cf|shdnotes}} Grants {{M|unobstructed movement}} and {{M|movement speed}} bonus.
*** Recasting the ability refreshes both buff durations and updates the ability components to the current level.
*** Both buffs [[dispels]] in the following conditions:
**** Upon reaching the {{M|cast point}} of abilities, including item abilities.
**** Upon a successful attack.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}

***#** The total {{M|attack range}} for the attack is defined as:
***#*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Attack Range|AtkRange]] {{=}} {{#expr:+{{Show|H|Nyx Assassin|atkrange}}+{{Show|H|Nyx Assassin|bound radius}}+{{#var:Vendetta value3}}}} + Enemy[[Unit Size#Bound Radius|BoundRadius]]}}
***#** This ability component does not affect the following units:
***#*** {{M|Buildings}}
***#*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
***# Applies {{A|Nyx Assassin|Mana Burn}} corresponding to the applied {{M|spell damage}}.
***# Nyx's attack instance.
***# Applies {{A|Nyx Assassin|Mana Burn}} corresponding to the applied {{M|attack damage}}.
<hr>
* {{cf|shdnotes}} Acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}} does not update the current instance.
